rule_rule_names: High-Risk Entity with Strong Context Risk
Outlier with Very Strong Model Risk
Product Amount Spike with High Risk
High Global Amount Ratio with High Risk
rule_explanations:
Very high anomaly score combined with many high anomaly flags. This is the strongest high-precision fraud segment.
Entity is high-risk and transaction context risk is also high. This captures suspicious repeat entity behavior.
Transaction is a statistical outlier and the anomaly score is already high.
Transaction amount is extremely unusual and the anomaly score is high.
Transaction occurred outside business hours with high anomaly score and dense anomaly signals.
Transaction amount is far above product-level average and the anomaly score is high.
Transaction amount is much higher than the global median and the anomaly score is high.
Multiple anomaly signals fired together while the anomaly score is high.
Transaction originated from a very new account (first transaction within the last 2 hours) with a notable anomaly score. Mimics a velocity check: fraudsters often open accounts and transact immediately.
Transaction occurred at night and the entity trust score is very low. Combines temporal risk (off-hours activity typical of foreign / automated fraud) with a low-trust entity profile.
